node.label: Abnormal peripheral myelination
node.definition: An abnormality of the myelination of motor and sensory peripheral nerves. These are axons for motor nerves and dendrites for sensory nerves in the strict anatomic sense.

evidence.snippet: Autosomal dominant Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2Z: Abnormal peripheral myelination (frequency HP:0040282) [TAS]
